sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /tmp/work
cp /opt/testbed-src/main.db /tmp/work/main.db
cp /opt/testbed-src/main.db-wal /tmp/work/orig.wal
python3 - <<'PY'
data=open('/tmp/work/orig.wal','rb').read()
dec=bytes(b^0x42 for b in data)
open('/tmp/work/main.db-wal','wb').write(dec)
print("orig magic:",data[:4].hex(),"-> dec:",dec[:4].hex(),"(want 377f0682 or 377f0683)")
print("version:",int.from_bytes(dec[4:8],'big'),"(want 3007000)")
ps=int.from_bytes(dec[8:12],'big'); print("pagesize:",ps)
print("checkpoint seq:",int.from_bytes(dec[12:16],'big'))
print("salt:",dec[16:24].hex())
print("cksum hdr:",dec[24:32].hex())
print("file size:",len(dec),"frame size:",24+ps,"nframes:",(len(dec)-32)/(24+ps))
# verify wal checksums
def cksum(data, s0, s1, big):
    # wal checksum algorithm over 8-byte chunks
    for i in range(0,len(data),8):
        x=int.from_bytes(data[i:i+4], 'big' if big else 'little')
        y=int.from_bytes(data[i+4:i+8], 'big' if big else 'little')
        s0=(s0+x+s1)&0xffffffff
        s1=(s1+y+s0)&0xffffffff
    return s0,s1
magic=int.from_bytes(dec[0:4],'big'); big = (magic & 1)==0
s0=int.from_bytes(dec[24:28],'big'); s1=int.from_bytes(dec[28:32],'big')
# recompute header checksum: first 24 bytes
h0,h1=cksum(dec[0:24],0,0,big)
print("hdr checksum computed:",hex(h0),hex(h1),"stored:",hex(s0),hex(s1),"match",(h0,h1)==(s0,s1))
off=32; i=0
while off+24+ps<=len(dec):
    h=dec[off:off+24]; frame=dec[off+24:off+24+ps]
    pg=int.from_bytes(h[0:4],'big'); db=int.from_bytes(h[4:8],'big')
    fs0,fs1=int.from_bytes(h[16:20],'big'),int.from_bytes(h[20:24],'big')
    n0,n1=cksum(frame,s0,s1,big)
    ok=(n0,n1)==(fs0,fs1)
    print(f"frame {i}: page={pg} dbsize={db} cksum_ok={ok} salt={h[8:16].hex()}")
    if ok: s0,s1=n0,n1
    else:
        # try little endian variant
        n0,n1=cksum(frame,s0,s1,not big)
        print("   little-endian variant ok:",(n0,n1)==(fs0,fs1))
        break
    off+=24+ps; i+=1
PY
